sloka: मैथिलीं रूपसम्पन्नां प्रत्यवेक्षस्व पार्थिव।त्वमेव तु सहास्माभी राघवे क्रोधमुत्सृज ।। ६.९३.६४ ।।
transliteration: maithilīṁ rūpasampannāṁ pratyavekṣasva pārthiva।tvameva tu sahāsmābhī rāghave krodhamutsṛja ।। 6.93.64 ।।

translations.english: "O Hero! Lord of Rakshasas! You made a vow of celibacy essential for Vedic study, so also engaged in your obligatory duties. Do you think of killing a woman?"
